format: free-standing Culver's Restaurant with drive-thru, land purchased and new building constructed

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Culver's® Restaurant is from $3,406,350 to $10,294,100. This includes a $45,000 to $65,000 initial franchise fee that must be paid to us.

fee.quote: If you are new to the System, you must pay an initial franchise fee of $65,000.
fee.note: $5,000 Application Fee credited toward the fee (refunded if not approved). $55,000 for an additional Restaurant by an existing franchisee with the same Operator; $45,000 under the Mentoring Program; Veterans' Discount reduces the fee by $10,000 (first Restaurant, full-time on-site owner-operator). 75% of the fee refunded if franchisee terminates before the fifth week of the Franchisee Development Program. Development Agreement Territory Fee $50,000 per Restaurant, refunded if scheduled dates are met.

royalty.quote: Service Fee 4% of Gross Sales (See Note 2) Payable monthly on or before the 10th day of the next month via EFT.

adFund.quote: Advertising Fee 2.5% of Gross Sales Payable monthly on or before the 10th day of the next month via EFT. Cooperative Advertising Up to 4% of your Gross Sales, as approved by a majority vote of the members of the Co-op Advertising Region.
adFund.note: 2.5% Advertising Fee (2.00% for agreements signed before March 31, 2012). Item 19 states 1.00% is the minimum local advertising spend required by the Franchise Agreement. Regional co-op up to 4% if formed.

otherRecurring.name: Gift Card Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently $.22 cents per redeemed transaction (may increase to $.35)

transferFee.amount: $10,000 plus our attorneys' fees; $5,000 plus our attorneys' fees if the buyer is an existing franchisee

item19.quote: Highest Sales $9,030,702 Lowest Sales $1,103,114 Average Sales $4,142,737 Median Sales $4,036,492 Of the 988 Franchised Restaurants, 450 (or 46%) met or exceeded the average sales.
item19.note: Franchised figures are sales only. Excludes 45 franchised Restaurants opened in 2025, 1 closed for relocation and 1 closed. Cost and income figures are for the 7 company-owned Wisconsin Restaurants only, and income is before rent, real estate taxes, personal property taxes, interest, depreciation, amortization and income tax; it also excludes initial franchise fee, management fees, travel and other listed expenses.

special: Initial investment includes purchase of land ($225,000 to $2,400,000) and construction of a new free-standing building ($2,047,000 to $4,391,000); leasing lowers the investment but rent then becomes an operating cost not shown in Item 19 income. Culver's requires 20% of total projected initial investment in cash or liquid assets. Item 19 profit figures come only from 7 company-owned Restaurants and exclude rent and financing costs.
issues: Cover gives the initial franchise fee range as $45,000 to $65,000 but the Item 7 table shows $35,000 to $65,000 (Item 7 note: veterans' discount of $10,000 can reduce the fee). The fee field uses the cover range.
